title / description.html: .vin-dialog__title, .vin-dialog__description (wire them up with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby)

footer.description: Actions at the end. Wrap a button in DialogClose to make it close the dialog.

open / defaultOpen.description: Use onOpenChange to hear about changes.

onSubmit.description: Wraps the body and footer in a form; a submit button sends it and closes the dialog.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A short form. In HTML it's the browser's <dialog>: commandfor opens it, form method=dialog closes it on submit.

examples.title: Long content
examples.description: The dialog scrolls inside; the page behind it stays put.

a11y: It's a native modal <dialog>: the page behind is inert, so Tab only reaches the dialog (and the browser's own toolbar). Escape closes it.
The title names it (aria-labelledby) and the description describes it (aria-describedby).
Focus moves to the first field when it opens, and back to the trigger when it closes. The close button comes last, so it isn't the first stop.
A click outside closes it (closedby="any"). Leave that off for forms where losing input would hurt.
